name: Pixel mark closes with an install line
looks: A small pixel-art style mark sits beside the project's wordmark on a dark ground; underneath, a one-line terminal install command types on in mono, the only remaining motion as the film ends.
build: Mark and wordmark arrive together (`y:10px -> 0`, power2.out, ~350ms); the install command clips in character by character, 30-40ms per character, with a blinking cursor at the end that holds after typing finishes.
sound: A soft low swell under the lockup's arrival, a quiet mechanical key-tick under the install line typing on.
prompt: Close on a small pixel-style mark beside the product's wordmark on a dark ground, then type on a single-line terminal install command underneath as the last piece of motion before the film holds and ends.
